hebrewText: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛י/ךָ וְ/עֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּ/ךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ

tokens.bdb: nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish)
father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais
